purpose: 클랜 멤버 10·20·50·100명 달성 배지 기본 스타일 5종 비교

concepts.name: 원탁의 동료
concepts.meaning: 같은 자리에 모이는 동료가 늘어나는 원탁
concepts.initialPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / product-mockup.
Create one polished LANDSCAPE comparison sheet, about 2.4:1 aspect ratio, showing exactly FOUR premium physical collectible enamel badges for a gaming clan's MEMBER COUNT milestones, left to right 10, 20, 50, 100 members.
Reference images show the existing clan badge series. Use ONLY their craftsmanship and materials: polished sculpted champagne-gold metal, rich emerald, pale mint and warm ivory hard enamel, crisp dimensional bevels and realistic highlights. Make a NEW membership/community motif. No tree emblem and no copying the reference silhouettes.
PRESENTATION: four fully visible front-facing upright badges in one evenly spaced horizontal row, same lighting and same maximum height, clean uniform matte charcoal #151918 background, small soft contact shadows, no case, no scenery, no ornamental presentation frame. Each badge fills most of its column with generous separation. Add understated ivory Korean sans-serif labels OUTSIDE and centered below the badges, exactly "10명", "20명", "50명", "100명". No other text, no numerals embedded inside the actual badges.
SERIES RULES: the four badges belong to ONE design family and grow through the specific motif progression below. Keep the champagne-GOLD outer metal finish and emerald/mint/ivory palette across ALL four stages; do not use bronze/silver/gold tier recoloring. More members should read as a more complete gathering through added symbolic elements, not simply a number swap. Counts of motif elements are symbolic and need not equal the literal member count.
QUALITY: elegant real hard-enamel collectible jewelry with tangible metal depth, not emoji, not a plain flat UI icon, not a generic people/avatar pictogram. Restrained detail that remains readable at 80px; strong silhouette, a few bold shapes, no tiny inscriptions, no giant glow, no random added gems, no branded game symbols, no hands with anatomical detail, no human faces. Preserve a coherent visual identity across the four milestones.
FAMILY DESIGN: a circular medallion with a substantial continuous champagne-gold beveled rim. Inside is an elegant TOP-VIEW circular communal table in rich emerald enamel with one small ivory four-point star at its center. Around the table are bold, evenly spaced sculpted ivory/mint chair-like seat markers, all contained inside the circular rim, visibly representing companions gathered at one table. Do not draw generic avatar heads.
PROGRESSION: 10 members has FOUR seat markers; 20 has SIX; 50 has EIGHT; 100 has TEN, completing a full harmonious ring. Keep the circular medallion and central table exactly the same across the row; fill the gathering through seat count, not through extra filigree. The simple chunky chair shapes should look like jewelry relief, not a gear or machine cog.
